title: Infinity parity exemptions
description: Mods left out of the lobby's mod set: an installed ExtraOptions mod whose mod.json id equals an entry's id is exempt, whatever its files. tools/infmods.py check also refuses duplicate ids and any id that names a catalog.json mod.

id.description: The id ExtraOptions' loader gives the installed mod: the id in its mod.json (or, without one, its folder name), in the catalog's id form.

description.description: What the mod does and why it changes nothing for other players.
